items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Hilton Jefferson my dear friend is helping me with the two o‟clock feeding.

ctx.x: Number 24, 47th Avenue, I run into an old man up there who ran a gambling game. He said, “Son, gamblers don‟t work”. He said, “They sit around and wait for you guys that work to come up and they practice so they can beat you out of your money. Now if you want to gamble quit playing the bass and gamble”, he said, “But you‟re crazy, don‟t do them both” [laugh]. So I continued to play the bass. We got married after that. In 1947 I was speaking to Cab. I said you know my wife is pregnant. He said mine too. He says…
